blocks.text: Tramspool recalls movement along shared routes in the compact form of a wound mechanism. The little wings and turning center survive as a useful object; the name does not establish a particular lost tram line as historical fact.
A compact pearl and violet rail-token mechanism with asymmetrical bronze wings and a luminous teal spool.
One-shot use: The center wheel extends outward while a thick teal ribbon unwinds into a large loop. The game performs the final fade.
18 silver. Exhaustion severity −2; reaching zero clears the condition. Energy +12; Health +3. Recovery timers become 75% of their remaining time; Potion Boost gives +1 to skills for 5 minutes.
Original PixelLab artwork and reviewed use animation, October 28, 2026. Image 43e4a805-9951-4d4d-987b-f2608c8ceca8; animation 08edbf69-fc1b-46ca-bcd5-03bde21826e1. Reduced motion holds a still.
